label: Same-exercise operation unity needs intrinsic realization and complete individuation
paraphrase: For any shared CausalityFrame and selected actual bearer/exercise, the subtype of occurring operations at that bearer and exercise is a subsingleton IF the bearer is constitutively simple, every selected operation's realizer is a real constituent of that bearer, and the supplied bearer/exercise/complete-immediate-realizer profile is injective on operation tokens. This is a local application of the earlier realizer-collapse law; it asserts neither an existing operation nor equality across different exercises. The completeness and intrinsic-realization applications are OPEN. A common subject, faculty, remote cause, realizer or extensional object profile alone does not supply them; objects are not the operation-token carrier.
